verdict.rationale: Maritime documents sleep/wake for agents running in micro-VMs with persistent storage. Sleeping agents wake automatically on messages or visits, and the Files API can reach an agent's disk even while it sleeps, so filesystem state survives a sleep/wake cycle. Memory preservation is not evidenced: the three-endpoint contract suggests the container itself handles sleep/wake rather than the platform snapshotting memory. Sleep also appears to be idle-driven rather than an explicit developer pause/resume call. missing for 10: explicit developer-initiated pause/resume API, documented preservation of in-memory/process state across resume, independent or hands-on corroboration.
